def solve_problem():

    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.98, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 1.7 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.71, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 5.32 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=15.98, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 6.98 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=9.57, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 3.19 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.11, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 3.56 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.47, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 8.29 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.73, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 2.56 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.18, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_7')
    lin_expr += 5.85 * vars['Var_7']
    vars['Var_8'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=12.95, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_8')
    lin_expr += 5.06 * vars['Var_8']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(4.5 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.03 * vars['Var_3'] + 1.44 * vars['Var_4'] + 3.38 * vars['Var_5'] + 5.11 * vars['Var_6'] + 8.06 * vars['Var_7'] + 0.74 * vars['Var_8'] >= 194.95, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(3.14 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.98 * vars['Var_2'] + 3.4 * vars['Var_3'] + 0.52 * vars['Var_4'] + 7.7 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.15 * vars['Var_6'] + 1.06 * vars['Var_7'] >= 148.63, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(4.52 * vars['Var_3'] + 3.98 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.4 * vars['Var_5'] + 9.89 * vars['Var_6'] + 8.53 * vars['Var_7'] >= 171.26, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(8.57 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.94 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.7 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.96 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.16 * vars['Var_5'] + 0.91 * vars['Var_6'] + 9.95 * vars['Var_7'] >= 362.86, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(0.67 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.3 * vars['Var_1'] + 0.71 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.99 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.18 * vars['Var_7'] >= 154.1, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(1.55 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.31 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.17 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.37 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.22 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.94 * vars['Var_5'] >= 176.19, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(3.64 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.08 * vars['Var_2'] + 1.27 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.36 * vars['Var_5'] + 5.18 * vars['Var_7'] >= 144.66, name='C6')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
